title: An interview with Naomi Gleit, Meta's head of product who joined the company 20 years ago, on Zuckerberg's "unfair" reputation, AI agents' capabilities, more (Zoe Kleinman/BBC)
summary: Zoe Kleinman / BBC: An interview with Naomi Gleit, Meta's head of product who joined the company 20 years ago, on Zuckerberg's “unfair” reputation, AI agents' capabilities, more — When Naomi Gleit joined Meta nearly 20 years ago, she was the firm's 29th employee.
